verdict.rationale: Fellow documents capturing in-person meetings, but only via desktop audio capture (fellow-docs-20). Those conversations become searchable full transcripts in the workspace (fellow-docs-21), and an API upload-from-URL endpoint offers a workaround for bringing in externally recorded audio (fellow-docs-37). Nothing in the evidence mentions a mobile app for recording, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: any evidence of a mobile recording app, mobile-originated transcription, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-person capture.
